correctness.rationale: Fresh exact enumeration of all 64 ambient words reproduces the pointwise certificate: for every word x, the sum of the stated received-word weights over its two-deletion descendants, plus the 2/5 endpoint correction for 000000 or 111111, is at least one. The eight weights sum to 16/5, so any list-size-two code has size at most 2(16/5)+4/5=36/5<8. Independently, the seven displayed codewords have maximum received-word multiplicity exactly two. This proves the upper bound and attainment without extrapolating from finite experiments.
